units.source_text: 源氏靠在屋角的栏杆上，向庭中及室内眺望。

en.t: Genji leaned on the railing at the corner of the room and gazed out into the garden and around the interior.

units.source_text: 但见众侍女大都还穿着深墨色的丧服。

en.t: He saw that most of the serving women were still wearing deep black mourning robes.

units.source_text: 也有几个改穿了寻常颜色的衣服，但也不是华丽的绫绸。

en.t: A few had changed into garments of ordinary colors, but even these were not made of splendid patterned silk.

units.source_text: 他自己所穿便袍，颜色虽是寻常的，但很朴素，没有花纹。

en.t: The casual robe he himself wore was ordinary in color, yet very plain and without any pattern.

units.source_text: 室内布置陈设也很简单。

en.t: The arrangement and furnishings of the room were also very simple.

units.source_text: 四周气象萧索，不胜岑寂之感，遂赋诗云：

en.t: Everything around him felt bleak and desolate, and overcome by the sense of lonely stillness, he composed this poem:
